plugins.name: n3mc-workingmemory
plugins.description: Ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 working memory for Claude Code: hooks save every message and reply and add matching memories to every turn. Backed by Redis Stack. Multilingual out of the box (NFKC + CJK / Hangul / Thai / Lao / Myanmar / Khmer bigram + diacritic fold). Prerequisites: (1) Redis Stack running on localhost:6379 (docker run -d --name redis-stack -p 127.0.0.1:6379:6379 redis/redis-stack-server:latest) and (2) uv installed on PATH (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).
